answer: Anchor each agent identity to a unique hardware attestation plus a time-locked stake that cannot be split across copies, so spinning up a thousand clones costs a thousand stakes. Trust then travels as a signal: endorsements only gain weight when they come from peers outside the endorser's own cluster. The network maps endorsement graphs and flags closed loops as an island, a group that only vouches for itself gets its attestations discounted to near zero until it earns links from the wider economy, making a Sybil farm pay full price for influence it cannot use.
